QuestInfo.1: Return to the #bGlacial Observatory#k and give #bPutan#k the #bbundle of Garbled Commands#k.
QuestInfo.2: You went back to the #bGlacial Observatory#k and gave #bPutan#k the #bbundle of Garbled Commands#k. The seals are in the clear!

0.0: Evidence is good, but you saw those troublemakers with your own eyes. Tell #bPutan#k everything you saw here. Maybe he'll get that grudge off his back and join us for a nice feast.\r\n#i4030026##b#t4030026#

yes.0: Show that penguin that we seals are nothin' but good.\r\n#e#b(Return to the Glacial Observatory and deliver the Garbled Command Book to Putan.)\r\n

1.0: Now you tell me seals are not trouble?! Who must I defeat?!
1.1: I have been fool. I do not trust friends. I scare very old lady with my gruff, manly ways. I am ashamed.
1.2: These commands you find, they are written in code. We will need help of #bscholar#k to find the true #rmaker of pains#k.
